systems.system: Janela Única de Concessão de Direitos Fundiários
systems.country_label: Janela Única de Concessão de Direitos Fundiários
systems.platform: technological platform integrating the public services and bodies that take part in land concession
systems.owner: instituted by Presidential Decree 84/25; technical instruction by the Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola for concessions above the municipal administrator's competence
systems.tiers: requests enter at the Secretaria of the Municipal Administration, electronically or on paper where conditions are lacking; the municipal urban-management and cadastre directorate handles inspection and demarcation

note: A decree: it makes the municipal administration's secretariat the entry point of an electronic platform and admits paper processing in localities without the technical conditions (Article 25), but states what is to happen, not what any office has. A law places nothing.
